findings.current: What’s the difference between saying “tie someone up” and “secure someone”?
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source’s crude euphemism joke with a literal restatement of the preceding exchange, losing both the shit-versus-feces comparison and Taekyung’s irreverent register.
findings.rationale: Taekyung specifically compares Jeok Cheongang’s substitution of “secure” for “tie up” to using the more polite word 대변 instead of 똥.
findings.replacement: How was that any different from calling shit “feces”?
findings.source: 똥이 아니라 대변이라고 하는 거랑 뭐가 다른 거야.

findings.current: “Your energy recovers quickly because you’re young. We can move on to the next step right away.”
findings.defect: “Energy” is ambiguous in this Murim context and can be mistaken for internal energy, while 기력 here means physical strength or vitality.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang is commenting on Taekyung’s general physical recovery after collapsing, not specifically the restoration of his internal energy.
findings.replacement: “I suppose being young means you recover your strength quickly. We can move on to the next step right away.”
findings.source: 젊은 놈이라 그런지 기력도 금방 회복되는군.

findings.current: Unlike Jin Taekyung’s bloodshot eyes, sharpened by unbearable pain, Jeok Cheongang’s eyes gleamed with heat.
findings.defect: “Sharpened by unbearable pain” incorrectly modifies the eyes and introduces an image absent from the source; the pain has made Taekyung’s eyes bloodshot.
findings.rationale: The source directly attributes the bloodshot condition of Taekyung’s eyes to the unbearable pain and contrasts them with the heat gleaming in Jeok Cheongang’s eyes.
findings.replacement: Unlike Jin Taekyung’s eyes, bloodshot from unbearable pain, Jeok Cheongang’s gleamed with heat.
findings.source: 참을 수 없는 고통에 핏발 선 진태경의 눈동자와는 달리 적천강의 그것은 열기로 번뜩이고 있었다.

findings.current: A trained fighting bull sometimes forgot how to charge.
findings.defect: “Trained” reverses the metaphor’s relevant quality: 길든 means tamed or domesticated, not trained for combat.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang’s point is that restraining and taming the newly introduced energy too soon could rob it of its force, just as a tamed bull may forget how to charge.
findings.replacement: A tamed fighting bull sometimes forgot how to charge.
findings.source: 길든 투우(鬪牛)는 돌격하는 방법을 종종 까먹는 법.

summary: One major humor/register mistranslation and three localized terminology or wording issues.
